question: Where can I get a list of commercial ports in Spain, with location, port authority and annual cargo, passengers and vessel calls?

answer.summary: For the 46 state-owned ports of general interest (28 Port Authorities), Puertos del Estado publishes everything asked, per port: an ArcGIS FeatureServer (port points, AP, cargo t, TEU, vessel calls, passengers, 2010-2024) and the Anuario 2025 XLSX (2025 data, coordinates in degrees-minutes). Regional (non-state) commercial ports have no national list; only Catalonia, Galicia and Canarias (passengers) were found, partially.
main_caveats: The ArcGIS traffic table stops at 2024; the Anuario 2025 XLSX (embedded in the PDF) has 2025. Monthly summaries exist per Port Authority, not per port.
Puertos del Estado data covers only the 46 state ports; commercial ports run by regions (e.g. Palamos, Garrucha, Ribadeo) are in separate regional sources.
Port coordinates are whole or decimal arc-minutes (about 1-2 km); Anuario sheet 2_1 has Arinaga at 25º24W (wrong, about 737 km offshore).
'Vessels' are merchant ship calls, not unique ships; passengers are movements. Glossary says gross weight excludes tares, tables footnote says tares included.
No open licence: puertos.es aviso legal requires prior written authorisation for reproduction/exploitation; the ArcGIS item states no licence.
answer.confidence_reason: State-port answer verified by download and cross-checked (2024 total matches in two sources); regional coverage is a sample of 4 of ~10 coastal regions.

how_to_use.example_result: 3_5_2.xlsx row 51: Valencia | TEU 5603223 | merchant ships 5991 | GT 275806708 | non-cruise passengers 861746 | cruise 799050 | total 1660796. 3_5_1.xlsx row 51: Valencia total 72844635 t. 2_1.xlsx row 53: Valencia | 0º18,1'O | 39º26,9'N
steps: Download the PDF (25.9 MB, Content-Type application/pdf) and extract the 30 embedded XLSX with pdfdetach -saveall into an empty directory.

Join sheets by port name: 3_5_1 (tonnes), 3_5_2 (TEU, calls, passengers) and 2_1 (position). Names differ between sheets, normalise accents/case/trailing spaces (Alcudia/Alcúdia, Puerto Rosario vs Puerto del Rosario, 'Puerto de Santa Maria' vs 'El Puerto de Sta. Maria').
Forward-fill column A (Port Authority) in 3_5_1/3_5_2: it is filled only on the first port of each authority (merged cells). Drop the TOTAL row (row 54).
Convert degrees-minutes (accept both 38º20'N and decimal minutes 39º26,9'N) to decimal degrees; O = west (negative).
reading_traps: 48 port rows but 46 ports of general interest: includes Zona Franca, Puerto de Santa Maria, La Cabezuela-Puerto Real, Salinetas, Arinaga (ArcGIS layer tags 6 of them as 'Puertos con Valor Estadistico').
Sheet 2_1.xlsx: Arinaga longitude is 25º24'O (typed), which falls about 737 km west of the Canary Islands; the ArcGIS layer has 15º23'O. 1 of 52 coordinates tested fell outside Spain.
Coordinates are whole or decimal minutes only (1 arc-minute about 1.85 km latitude): good for a map of ports, not for distances to quays.

Port Authority totals (3_1_x, 3_3_1, 3_4_1_x) are per authority, not per port: Baleares, Bahia de Cadiz, Las Palmas, Santa Cruz de Tenerife, Valencia, Almeria, Ferrol-San Cibrao each cover several ports.
Glossary defines gross weight as excluding tares, yet table footnotes say 'Incluye cargas, descargas, transitos, transbordos y taras'; both statements are in the same document (unresolved).

steps: Count: .../Trafico_Puertos_(Vista)/FeatureServer/0/query?where=Año=2024&returnCountOnly=true&f=json returns 48; all 720 rows come in one call (maxRecordCount 1000/2000).

Port coordinates are arc-minute values converted to decimals (Latitud 43.35 = 43º21'N): precision about 1-2 km. 49 points tested: all inside Spain's bounding box; Arinaga is correct here (-15.406, 27.849), unlike the Anuario sheet 2_1.
Item description is empty and the service has no licence text; the ArcGIS item was last modified 2023 while data go to 2024.

operators.note: 28 Port Authorities manage the 46 state ports; regional agencies (Ports de la Generalitat, Portos de Galicia, APPA, Puertos Canarios, PortsIB...) run non-state ports; terminals are private concessions.

publication_obligation.what_must_be_published: Art. 18.2: 'Las Autoridades Portuarias suministraran a dicho Organismo Publico la informacion que les sea requerida'; art. 18.1.n gives Puertos del Estado 'Elaborar las estadisticas de trafico'. It obliges APs to supply data to PdE, not to publish.
publication_obligation.frequency: Monthly submissions to Puertos del Estado; annual yearbook (October)

consolidated_republication.note: Puertos del Estado republishes what the 28 APs report (yearbook, monthly summary, ArcGIS layers). Regional ports: Idescat aggregates Catalonia, ISTAC aggregates Canarias passengers; no national aggregator.

checked_pages.saw: Annual yearbooks 2020-2025 (PDF) and Memorias of the 28 Port Authorities
Monthly summary XLSX/PDF; method note: APs send monthly files, PdE validates and aggregates
Corporate viewer; its data.json names the FeatureServers with port points and traffic table

national_registry.note: The only official list is the 46 ports of general interest (TRLPEMM annex I) with PdE service-zone layers; no national registry covers regional ports.

checked_pages.organization: Agencia Estatal Boletin Oficial del Estado
checked_pages.saw: Art. 4.1: 'Son puertos de interes general los que figuran en el anexo I'; regional ports under regional competence
Homepage lists the 28 Port Authorities; no list of regional ports
Service zones of the state ports only (INSPIRE), WMS/WFS
Dataflow for Spain lists statistical ports incl. regional ones (Palamos, Garrucha, Alcanar)

checked_pages.organization: Ports de la Generalitat de Catalunya
checked_pages.saw: Only its own ports (Palamos, Vilanova, La Rapita, Alcanar...)

recipe: Official state ports: use rank 2 (API) for 2010-2024 and rank 1 XLSX for 2025; no manual work needed.

Regional ports of Catalonia: open the latest Anuari PDF (tested 2025), run pdftotext -layout, find 'Moviment de mercaderies per ports' (cargo, line 672), 'Vaixells mercants' (calls, p.14) and 'Passatgers per tipologia de trafic' (p.29); Catalan numbers use dot as thousands separator.
Other regions: find the regional port agency's yearbook/memoria; Galicia's 2025 memoria only gives system totals; Andalucia APPA page lists ports but no statistics (not found).
Zone vertices of a state port: BOE order with ETRS89/REGCAN95 UTM coordinates (tested for Marin TMA/690/2023): transform with the stated CRS (huso 29 for Marin).
if_unstructured.location_method: State ports: rank 2 points (arc-minute) or rank 4 polygons. Regional ports: no coordinates found; use the region's cartography or OSM (rank 7, spot checks only).
cross_with: Rank 4 polygons by cod_ap/puerto to validate rank 2 points
Eurostat rank 6 for regional port names
UN/LOCODE column in rank 8 for joining

where_published.name: Memoria anual / memoria estadistica of each Port Authority (via puertos.es)
where_published.what: PDF per AP with traffic tables, quay lists and location; 28 links on the annual page
where_published.how_to_search_inside: Pick the AP from the table; pdftotext -layout; search index entries Trafico/Buques/Pasajeros. Some are placeholders (Valencia 2024 is a 1-page notice).

example_document.what_it_gives: Memoria estadistica 2024 Port de Barcelona (102 pp): 'Longitud 2º 10' E / Latitud 41º 21' N'; section 4.1.1 Pasajeros, 4.2.1 Buques mercantes; quays with length, draught and use

where_published.name: BOE - Ordenes TMA of delimitacion de espacios y usos portuarios
where_published.what: Ministerial orders with UTM vertex coordinates of each port service zone
where_published.how_to_search_inside: BOE search by title text 'delimitacion de los espacios y usos portuarios' and the port name; vertices are in the order annex

example_document.what_it_gives: Orden TMA/690/2023, Marin y Ria de Pontevedra: 'coordenadas UTM (ETRS89, huso 29)' of the land service zone; (Santa Cruz de La Palma, TMA/692/2023: REGCAN95 / UTM)

where_published.name: Ports de la Generalitat - Anuari estadistic
where_published.what: Yearbooks 2021-2025 with cargo, ships and passengers of its ports
where_published.how_to_search_inside: Table of contents; Moviment de mercaderies per ports

example_document.what_it_gives: p.18: 'Total port' Palamos 154.447; Vilanova i la Geltru 24.754; Alcanar 1.092.620

related_not_answering.name: Eurostat country-level maritime datasets (mar_mg_aa_cwh, mar_mp_aa_cph)
related_not_answering.why: National totals per country, not per port.

related_not_answering.name: Datos abiertos: Estadisticas de trafico maritimo (Autoridad Portuaria de Baleares)
related_not_answering.why: Only distribution listed is a PNG image; its site seu.portsdebalears.gob.es answers with a Cloudflare challenge and the five ports are already in ranks 1-2.

related_not_answering.name: Portos de Galicia memoria 2025 system totals
related_not_answering.why: Regional totals (1.1 M t) are not per-port cargo.

open_questions: Anuario 2025 glossary says gross weight excludes tares while table footnotes say tares are included: needs Puertos del Estado to clarify.
Eurostat mar_go_am_es gives Algeciras 78 209 kt for 2025 and the Anuario 100 679 kt (94 195 kt without supplies/fish/local): the reconciliation is not published in the pages opened.
Anuario sheet 2_1 Arinaga longitude (25º24'O) conflicts with the ArcGIS layer (15º23'O): which is the official value needs confirming with Puertos del Estado.

history.note: First pass: state ports fully answered (yearbook XLSX + ArcGIS API); regional ports only sampled (Catalonia, Galicia, Canarias).

Public body managing one or more state ports (28)
Port not of general interest, run by a region
Ship call (statistics count calls, not unique ships)
Tonnes of goods handled (loaded, unloaded, transit, transhipment)
Service zone; Delimitacion de Espacios y Usos Portuarios (ministerial order)
